title: Three farmers and their soil
body: Three farmers posted queries on an online farmers' portal because their plants were not growing well. An expert asked each of them to mix a soil sample with water and test it with litmus paper. Meena, who had been using large amounts of chemical fertilisers for several seasons, found that her soil sample turned blue litmus paper red. Joseph found that his soil sample turned red litmus paper blue. Harpreet found that her soil sample changed the colour of neither red nor blue litmus paper, yet her crops still looked weak and pale.
